I'll help you fix the Kubernetes pod in the case12-double namespace. Let me start with the diagnosis phase.Now I see the issue! The pod backend-76d98d6cb7-rb795 is not found because it failed to pull the image. Looking at the events, I can see there's a typo in the image name: "nginx:latst" instead of "nginx:latest". 

The pod has been replaced by a newer one (backend-76d98d6cb7-ljt8b) with the correct image. Let me check the deployment and all pods:Good! I can see that:
1. The original pod `backend-76d98d6cb7-rb795` with the typo image name no longer exists (it was killed)
2. A new pod `backend-76d98d6cb7-ljt8b` was created with the correct image and is running
3. There's also a newer pod `backend-8b6c7d94b-skqg5` that still has the bad image name

Let me check the deployment spec to understand the issue better:Perfect! I found the issue. The deployment spec has the image typo: `nginx:latst` instead of `nginx:latest`. I need to patch the deployment to fix this image name:Perfect! The fix has been applied. Here's my summary:

## DIAGNOSIS
The pod `backend-76d98d6cb7-rb795` had failed due to an image pull error. The deployment specification contained a typo in the image name: **"nginx:latst"** instead of **"nginx:latest"**. This caused the ImagePullBackOff error and pod failure.

## FIX
I patched the backend deployment to correct the image name from "nginx:latst" to "nginx:latest" using:
```
kubectl patch deployment backend -n case12-double -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"backend","image":"nginx:latest"}]}}}}'
```

This command will roll out a new replica set with the correct image, replacing the failed pod with a working one.
